text:
maria: quick win from the research lab: move scope toggle into the main header so keyboard users can reach it in compact mode. also add a persistent "Download PDF invoice" button when org scope is selected.

alex: header getting crowded. can we iconify it on small widths? share a mock pls.

maria: mock posted: https://figma.redwood/header-scope-mini (page 1). idea: pill collapses to icon under 480px. token chip next to scope opens a right drawer.

nina: a11y notes: use aria-pressed on toggle, announce total via aria-live when scope changes, and ensure focus ring contrast in dark mode.

sam: implementation: don't fetch invoices on render. call /api/invoices?scope=org&format=pdf on click. feature-flag the header CTA for Dedicated customers. ETA PR Fri.
